title: Unclassified assignment literal: one-property twin (context)
summary: 9 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is unchanged but the carrier lacks the marker that makes the value identifiable. Legacy mutation notes: context: field name build_id carries no credential meaning vs sensitive api_key; value, delimiter and quoting unchanged, context: field name build_id carries no credential meaning vs sensitive client_secret; value, delimiter and quoting unchanged, and context: field name build_id carries no credential meaning vs sensitive password; value, delimiter and quoting unchanged. Twin of "Unclassified assignment literal: must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
